title: File:Centro Hist. de Paraty - 3 (5545421672).jpg
claims: The photograph shows a cobbled street in Paraty's historic centre at dusk: white colonial facades on both sides, warm-lit doorways in red, yellow and green frames, wall lanterns and wet stones reflecting the light; the street is otherwise empty.

Commons titles the file Centro Hist. de Paraty - 3 (5545421672).jpg and describes it as Paraty (RJ), Brazil; it is categorised under Historic center of Paraty. It shows the historic setting, not the 2027 start arch, finish line, start/finish barriers, course markings, timing mat or race-day crowd.

The author is Leandro Neumann Ciuffo; the file is licensed CC BY 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2011-03-19 at 18:15; the original is 2,896 x 1,944 pixels and 2,471,553 bytes; the file page gives a camera location of 23.218368 S, 44.720116 W.
The route page uses a 960 x 644 copy of 151,232 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Leandro Neumann Ciuffo, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
